name: Avatar
summary: Represent a person or entity with a photo, initials, or an icon — solo or in a stacked group, with an optional round add button.
highlights: Solo or stacked in a group, with an add button
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-avatar> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Avatar is a small matrix: THREE content modes (an image `src`, the initials of `name`, or an `<aha-icon>` glyph via `icon`), two `shape`s (circle · square), a named or numeric `size` (small 24 · default 40 · large 64), and a `color` ground tint. A sibling <aha-avatar-group> overlaps stacked children and collapses the overflow past `max` into a trailing +N chip; its opt-in `add` appends a round + button (the group's size and shape) that fires `aha-add` and overlaps the whole group only slightly (an eighth of the size) instead of the default stack overlap. The avatar itself is a static display marker with no motion; the add button animates its hover, press and focus on the motion tokens. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitives are defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Size
spec.value: small 24 · default 40 · large 64 (named), or any numeric px via `size`

spec.label: Initials
spec.value: bg-accent #E70E680D, text-default #1A1A1A, SemiBold 600; the type-scale step nearest 38% of the size, never below 12px (12 at 24, 16 at 40, 24 at 64)

spec.label: Image
spec.value: object-fit cover, clipped to shape; if it fails to load, the no-src content (icon, else initials of `name`) shows until `src` changes

spec.label: Icon
spec.value: <aha-icon> glyph by name, ~half the avatar diameter, currentColor

spec.label: Color
spec.value: ground tint from an --aha-* token via `color` (default brand tint)

spec.label: Group
spec.value: stacked overlap (-10px), 2px container-white ring; grounds rotate Vivid Pink 5% #E70E680D (ink), 30% #E70E684D (ink), 100% #E70E68 (white) so neighbours never match; an avatar with its own `color` keeps it; +N chip past `max` on grey 25 #F3F3F3

spec.label: Add button
spec.value: (group `add`) a round + after the avatars and the +N chip: the group's size and shape, the same 2px container-white ring; with `add` every avatar, the +N chip and the button overlap by only an eighth of the size (3px at 24, 5px at 40, 8px at 64) instead of the default stack overlap, so more of each initial shows; stacking runs left over right, so every avatar and the +N chip sit above the item to their right and the + button sits under the item on its left (it rises above its neighbour while hovered or keyboard-focused so its ring shows whole); white fill, grey edge #E3E3E3, ink #1A1A1A system-plus glyph (12 at 24, 16 at 40, 24 at 64); hover and press add Vivid Pink 5% #E70E680D, a Vivid Pink #E70E68 edge and a #DB005B glyph; keyboard focus draws the 2px Vivid Pink ring 2px outside; disabled is grey #E3E3E3 with a #B5B5B5 glyph

props.name: name
props.desc: Full name; initials are derived when no src/icon. Also the alt/aria-label

props.name: src
props.desc: Image URL; the photo content mode (overrides icon/initials). If the image fails to load, the avatar shows the no-src content (icon, else initials of `name`) until `src` changes

props.name: icon
props.desc: DS icon name (e.g. 'system-user'); the glyph content mode when no src

props.name: size
props.desc: 24 / 40 / 64 named steps, or any numeric px

props.name: color
props.desc: Ground tint — an --aha-* token suffix, e.g. 'bg-positive'

props.name: max
props.desc: (aha-avatar-group) collapse children past this count into a +N chip

props.name: add
props.desc: (aha-avatar-group) append a round + button after the avatars and overlap the whole group only slightly (an eighth of the size), the button tucked under the item on its left. Click, Enter or Space fires a bubbling, composed `aha-add` event

props.name: add-label
props.desc: (aha-avatar-group) accessible name of the add button, e.g. 'Invite people'

props.name: add-disabled
props.desc: (aha-avatar-group) disable the add button; it stays visible but fires no `aha-add`

whenToUse.when: identifying a person or entity — a presenter, a participant, an author
a stack of collaborators people can add to from the same spot (invite, share): the + sits on the stack it grows
a generic symbol, not a specific identity
labelling with a category rather than an identity

opinion.note: Always provide `name` even when `src` is set — it becomes the alt text and the initials shown when the image fails to load, until `src` changes. Prefer initials or a photo over a generic icon for a real identity; reserve the icon mode for a placeholder/guest slot. In a group, keep sizes uniform and set `max` so the +N chip stays legible. Give the add button an `add-label` that says what it adds ('Invite people', not 'Add'): it has no visible text. Set `add-label` on every real use so it names the action (e.g. 'Invite people', 'Add co-host'); the default 'Add person' is only a fallback. One add button per group; use an <aha-button> when the action is not about the people in the stack.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Avatar + Avatar-Group component sets (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): 'supports images, Icons, or letters' → three content modes; circle/square shapes; small/default/large sizes; a colour ground; and a stacked group with a +N overflow. Initials/icon ground uses bg-accent (#E70E680D) with text-default (#1A1A1A) — pale pink with black text, since pink text fails contrast on the tint; `color` overrides the ground with any --aha-* token. Circle is the pill radius; square is the default 8 radius. Group children wear a 2px bg-container ring and overlap; the +N chip inherits the group size/shape. The add button takes the secondary Button's colours and focus ring, drawn round on the avatar grid so it sits flush in the stack (the Presenter top bar).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: size 40 default; small 24 / large 64 named steps
src renders cover image; icon renders an <aha-icon> glyph by name
group overlaps children + collapses overflow into a +N chip past max
group `add` renders a round + button at the group size/shape that fires aha-add

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is the default 40px initials circle; the measure also asserts the square shape (radius 8) and the large (64) size on sibling avatars, plus that the group renders a +N overflow chip and that a group with `add` renders a 40px round add button.
